sources.title: PBS SPI Annexure: consumer prices for week ended 22 October 2026
sources.note: Appendix-A LOWER header row119 labels M119 as National Average; row120 M/N/O are MIN/AVG/MAX. Top header row3 M/O are Sialkot and were NOT used. National data rows start123, with M/O at zero-based indices12/14. Re-audited every included item by independently taking min across positive city MINs and max across positive city MAXs for all17 cities: first7 cities at row=item+6, next7 at row=item+64, final3 at row=item+122; city MIN indices3+3*c and MAX indices5+3*c. All9 included item ranges exactly matched lower-block M/O. Covers50 markets in17 cities. Gram pulse is not used for whole chickpeas. This is an observed survey range, not a promise for every shop.

sources.title: Al-Fatah boneless chicken breast, Faisalabad, 1 kg
sources.note: Direct Shopify product .js endpoint returned 1 KG price 117300 paisa (PKR 1,173); 500 GM 58650 paisa. A single branch-specific quote; no live-broiler conversion.

sources.title: Al-Fatah Nature’s Own white oats pouch, 1,000 g
sources.note: Direct product .js returned price 84500 paisa (PKR 845) for 1,000 g. Single product quote; other brands and smaller packs differ.

sources.title: Al-Fatah white chana bareek, 1 kg
sources.note: Direct product .js returned 31500 paisa (PKR 315) for whole white chana 1 kg. This replaces the older indexed PKR285 quote and is distinct from split daal chana.

sources.title: Al-Fatah AUK Premium Zehdi dates, 500 g
sources.note: Direct product .js returned 33500 paisa (PKR335) per 500 g; normalized to PKR670/kg. Typical edible dates; premium Ajwa/Mabroom prices are not substituted.

sources.title: Zaroori Saman shelled peanuts, 1 kg
sources.note: Fetched primary product page displays sale PKR1,350 and crossed-out PKR1,400, additional information weight 1 kg. Uses current displayed sale quote only; no shell-yield assumption. Unrelated seller health claims were not used.

eggs.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Farm eggs, original survey unit 1 dozen.

milk.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Loose fresh unboiled milk, original survey unit 1 litre. Packaged milk can cost more; heat/store safely.

yogurt.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Loose plain dahi, original survey unit 1 kg; not Greek/high-protein yogurt.

masoor.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Dry washed masoor, original survey unit 1 kg. Cooked serving cost requires a declared dry-to-cooked yield.

atta.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Wheat flour original survey unit 20 kg bag; divided by20. This is a bag-equivalent per-kg cost; small loose purchases may cost more.

rice.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Dry ordinary IRRI-6/9 rice, original survey unit 1 kg; not premium basmati.

banana.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Local bananas, original survey unit 1 dozen; fruit size and edible yield vary.

potato.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Raw potatoes, original survey unit 1 kg; peeling/cooking yield varies.

oil.basis: Observed nationwide min/max across surveyed markets on 22 October 2026. Dalda or similar cooking oil, original survey unit a 5 litre tin; divided by5.

chana.basis: Approximate single retail quote checked 28 October 2026, not a cross-market range. Whole dry white chickpeas; original unit1 kg. Not split gram pulse. Shipping, cooking fuel and extras excluded.

chicken.basis: Approximate single retail quote checked 28 October 2026, not a cross-market range. Raw boneless breast; original unit1 kg, branch Faisalabad. Cooked serving cost requires an explicit raw-to-cooked yield. Shipping, cooking fuel and extras excluded.

oats.basis: Approximate single retail quote checked 28 October 2026, not a cross-market range. Plain white oats; original pack1,000g. Shipping, cooking fuel and extras excluded.

peanuts.basis: Approximate single retail quote checked 28 October 2026, not a cross-market range. Shelled peanuts; original unit1kg. No shell conversion. Shipping, cooking fuel and extras excluded.

dates.basis: Approximate single retail quote checked 28 October 2026, not a cross-market range. Zehdi dates; original pack500g at PKR335; multiplied by2. Shipping, cooking fuel and extras excluded.
